item.title: North Korea launches ‘multiple’ ballistic missiles toward East Sea: ROK military

item.title: Takaichi calls North Korea a ‘nuclear-armed state,’ emphasizing threats to Japan
item.description: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi called North Korea a “nuclear-armed state” on Monday, stressing the growing threat that Tokyo faces from its neighbors. But her government responded the next day by reaffirming Tokyo’s longstanding policy of not recognizing the DPRK’s nuclear status, despite estimates that it already possesses 50 nuclear warheads. item.description: Russia is upgrading its only rail link to North Korea with new X-ray scanners for large cargo, a move the manufacturer described as part of efforts to improve detection of explosives and drugs amid growing commercial exchanges between the two sides. item.title: Busting the many myths of North Korea, from Juche to Kim Jong Il’s Russian name
item.description: North Korea is drowning in myths.
